analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 4 consecutive trading days. RSI has fallen from 83.9 to 66.3, exiting the overbought zone but remaining in neutral territory. MACD histogram improved from 0.0026 to 0.0014, but the improvement is minimal to confirm a trend reversal. Trading volume is at 0.56x the 5-day average, indicating low confidence in current price action. Weekly ADX at 39.6 suggests a clear trend, but daily directionality is unclear, requiring further indicator confirmation.
